content: Wanya anaerere ugavo rai
Weramu Yesus poroto kobe no Pukamo Saitun.
Awatan ngko dave pakare akato no Yavaro Amisye rai, muno vatano wanui rave ude irati Ai. Yesus tuna po manyao.
Umba kuruno makari mbaro Ananyao Musa rai muno vatano Parisi wo wanya anaerere ugavo rai inta raugav ude no Yesusa nui. Wo wanya umaso raugave usya nte no awa yasyin.
Umba wo raura ware, “Injayo Kurune, wanya so omamo reamo raijar weye reamo raen kavoe mo ayao kakai anaerere rave.
Musa apa ananyao inta mare wanya anaerere maisyare so omamo orame rave ramaug ava ngkakai. Weti, Kurune, Winya ana ndatantona mamo noare rui?”
Awa ana wo raura so ware wo Yesus atopan indamu payao tatugadi, weamo wo kakai rantuna Ai kobe. Weramu Yesus beaje po apa kawije veano ana ratoe no kopa.
Wo anajo tutir, weti beakaeyo naije Po raura akananto mansai pare, “Weapamo are pirati ayao kakai meweno ai, weamo manasyimbe po orame rave wanya so ramaug.”
Naije beakaje Po ratoe akato.
Weramu arono wo Yesus apa ayao so ranaun, unajivo nanentabo eve, weti manasyimbe ananuiny dave mansai. Unajiva mewen dave, weti Yesus obo no kobe no naije muno wanya umawe ma no tavona nene.
Yesus beakaeyo akato, Po raura nanto rai pare, “Inya, wanya winy, vatane umawe nawamo uta no rui? Inta ta no ra po mangke rapatimugo naija e?”

Ama ayao mo raura Yesus ai mare, “Injae, jewena.” Umba Yesus po raura nanto rai pare, “Risyamo syo mangke raugaje nai tavone jewen. Nyoronto muno vemo nyo ayao kakai rave akato inya, masyoto unumeso kobe.”
Yesus wepirati baro mine so rai

Umba Yesus po raura nanto vatano wanui mansai jakato pare, “Risyamo inaurata irati vare rai, ibaro vatano mine so mansanuga rai. Are pirati tavondi Rinai, opamo panya kaumudi rai jakatoe ramu, yara varo mo kove raunande mbaro anuga rai tutir.”
Vatano Parisi wo raura nanto Yesus ai ware, “Nya ayao wato mamaisye ramu, weye taune Winyo taune naura kakavimbe. Vatane po taune aura, weamo vatane wanave aije ramu.”

Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Risyamo syo taune inaura kakavimbe kai, weramu taune Syo inaura kakavimbe somamo tugae muno mamaisy, weye Risya no rai ti de mamo taune Syo raen muno Risya syakato rai mamo taune Syo raen tavon. Weramu weapamo wapantukambe Sya no rai ti de rai muno syakato raije rai.
Weapamo wapo mangke rapatimu mamaisyo vatano mine so awa ana udatantona rai vayave. Yara Risyamo syo mangke rapatimugo vatane inta ai ramu.
Weramu ranivara Syo mangke rapatimu, weamo mangke namije mamaisy, weye taune Ribui syo rapatimuge ramu, yara Injayo po inatutire pamo tavondi inautan.

Muno wapa Ananyao Musa ama ayao inta ratoe taiso: Vatane intabo po anakotare inta raura omamo mamai dainy, yara vatane jiruma aya ayao intabo irati anakotare umaso rai, weamo mamai to ti wamanave rai.
Weti vatane jiruma yo inaura kakavimbe taiso: manasyimbe, taune Risyo inaura kakavimbe, muno jirum, Injayo po inatutire po inaura kakavimbe.”
Naije wo raura akananto Ai ware, “Weti Nya Injaya nori rui?” Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Risy muno Sya Injaya, weapantatukambe Ririnsai. Ranivara wapo inaen, weamo Sya Injaya wapo aen to.”

Yesus po apa ananyao so raura aje no Yavaro Amisye ama uga rai, mararaijo bayaijo namirati vatane wo doije raugasyo raije rai. Muno vatane inta po aijare ramu, weye Apa masyoto Amisye po ratayao Aije mamai dainy.
Yesus apa no rai mamo mine so ma jewena

Umba Yesus po raura nanto vatano wanui mansai jakato pare, “Risyamo syoroto muno weapamo indati wapo inakani. Weramu wananta Rinai jewen, weye munijo syoroto rai mamo maweso weade rai jewen. Weapamo indati wakakai wapa ayao kakai rai.”
Weti akarijo Yahudi wo raura ware, “Veanimaibe Yesus po raura pare, ‘Munijo syoroto rai mamo maweso weade rai jewen’? Indako pare Po taune aubai dako?”
Umba Yesus po raura nanto mansai pare, “Weapamo vatano mine nawirati weap, yara Risyamo sya munije mi munijo ntiti warae. Mine somamo wapa munije mijem, yara Risyamo sya munije ma jewena.

Wemi mbewar umawe Syo raura wasai syare weapamo indati wakakai wapa ayao kakai rai. Weye ranivara wapanave Rinai jewen arono Syo inaura kakavimbe syare Risyamo are pi Risy, indati tugae rave wakakai kobe muno wapa ayao kakai mamo Amisye po rapaya wasaije ramu.”
Weti wo anajo ware, “Are pi Winy?” Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Veanimaibe syayao akanande wasai? Arono manasyinoe Syo inaura kakavimbe tenambe to.
Ayao rapatimu syare Syo raura wasai manakoe weye wapa ana wadave ngkakai. Injayo po inatutire Apa ayao mamai dave, muno ayao rui mirati idaranivo Ai wemi Syo raura kakavimbe irati vatano mine wasai.”
Yesus po Ajayo Amisye aura umaso, weramu vatano wanui nanawije wantatukambe rai.

Weti Po raura mansai pare, “Arono indati wapo Arikainyo Vatane inauseo inyo kapite rai, wea umba wapo raen Sya ayao syo inaura kakavimbe mamo mamai dave. Muno Risyamo sya ana syo rave mamo no no taune Rinai ma jewena. Yara ananyao rui mirati Injaya po raura Inai webo mirati Syo raura.
Wepirati po inatutir, muno tuna inautan tutir. Po inapaya syanya syayave ramu, weye Sya ana idave mamaisyo Apa bekere rai tenambe, ti anayanambe Rinai.”
Arono Yesus po ananyao kotare umaso raura, vatane wanui rave wanave Ai.
Yesus po Amisye apa ayao tugae raura
Naije Yesus po raura nanto vatano Yahudi nanawirati wanave Aije mai pare, “Ranivara weano tawan no Sya ayao rai, weapamo tugae rave Sya arakovo watavondi rinai nawirati weap.
Indati weapo Amisye apa ayao tugae raen, muno ayao tugae so mo wasapaya irati anakotaro mo wasaijaro arove rai.”

Umba wo raura akananto Yesus ai ware, “Veanimaibe Winyo raura nyare reamamo indati reampaya aro rai? Reamamo aneno Abraham apa susyo po reansampambe nawirati ream. Muno vatan inta wo reansaijaro arove ramu.”
Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Syo raura tugaive: are pirati po ayao kakaije rave, weamo ayao kakai mo aijaro arove.
Vatano aijaro arove ato siso yavaruga raije ramu. Yara arikainyo yavaruga opamo ato siso yavaruga rai no tawan tutir.
Maisyare omai ti, ranivara Arikainyo Amisy risyo wasapaya aro rai, weamo tugae rave wapaya rai kobe.
Weapamo Syo wasaen wana no Abraham apa susye rai, weramu wabeke damu wapo inaubaisy, weye Sya ayao mamo waponayo rai muno weapo raugave nsiso no wasanuga raije ramu.
Ana rui mirati Syo raeno sya Injaya nui, wemirati Syo raura wasai. Weramu weapamo ana rui mirati wapo raranivo wapa aja ai, wemirati weapo raijar.”

Umba wo raura akanande Yesus ai ware, “Reama injaya pirati Abraham.” Umba Yesus po raura mansai pare, “Weapamo Abraham apa arikainye nawirati weapa jewena, weye weapa ana wadave nsasyeo Abraham apa ana dave rai.

Weapa ana wadave mamo wabeke damu wapo inaubaisy. Weramu Risyamo syo ayao tugae obo raura wasai muno ayao tugae namije mamo Syo raraniv no Injayo Amisy ai. Vatano po ayao tugae raura pamo Abraham po aubaisye ramu.

Weti wapa ajae sasyeo Abraham ai. Muno wapa ana wadave mamo wapa aja apa ana dave mijem.” Naije wo raura ware, “Reamamo arikainyo insumaije jewena! Yara vatano Yahudi reama Injaya intabo dave, Opirati Amisye.”

Yesus po raura nanto mansai pare, “Ranivara Amisye pamo wapa Ajae waino ai ratire, weamo weamuinyo Inai, weye risyamo ino no Injayo Amisye ai umba syuje ti ide so. Muno ide irati taune Sya bekere rai ramu, yara Injayo Amisy po inatutir apa bekere rai.
Wabeanimaibe wananta Sya ayao so rai jewen? Indako waponae wapo Sya ayao raranivi?

Anakakai Akoe wepirati wapa Ajae waino ai, weti weabeto irati apa bekere rai. Anakakai Akoe wepirati po vatane maubaisy arono manasyin dave rai muno opamo anuga mbeto ayao tugae raije ramu, weye anuga mamo ayao tugae ravaki rai jewen. Po ayao aarurijate raura tutir, weye anuga ntairijo angkarije rai. Anakakai Akoe pamo vatano arurijat akoe pije muno ayao arurijat kotar vatano mine so wo raura omamo no no Anakakai Akoe ai po raugaje.
Weramu Risyo ayao tugae raura, muno weapanave Inai ramu.
Weapamo wananta ayao kakai inta rai no Rinai jewen. Risyo ayao tugae raura, weti wabeanimaibe weapanave Inai jewen?
Are pirati Amisye apa arikainye waino ai, opamo po Amisye apa ayaowe raraniv. Weramu wapo Apa ayaowe raranive jewen, weye weapamo Amisye apa arikainye waino wasai jewen.”
Yesus no wusyimbe, Po Abraham akivan
Umba vatano Yahudi wo Yesus aura tantunawi ware, “Reama ana reamo raura umawe mamo no rai tugae: Winyamo vatano Samaria pi Winy!
Muno anawayo kakaije siso nanuga rai to!”
Yesus po raura pare, “Anawayo kakai inta siso inanuga rai jewen. Ibeaje irati Sya Injaya ai, weramu weapo inaura tantunawi.
Risyamo syo tamo ntiti rakani taune inamarome ramu, yara Injayo Amisye wepirati po tamo ntiti raugaje Rinai. Wepirati indati po mangke rapatimugo vatano nanawirati wo inaura tantunawi mansai.
Syo raura tugaive: Are pi beto Sya ayao rai, opamo nanto wene raija nuge nuganuije ramu.”

Vatano Yahudi wo raura akananto Ai ware, “Wakoe! Winyo raura nyare, ‘Are pi beto Sya ayao rai, opamo nanto wene raija nuge nuganui ramu.’ Weramu Nya ayao so mamaisye ramu weye Abraham opamo kakai, maisyare omai tavon Amisye apa anawae wusyine nanawamo wene nde mansai tavon. Indako Winyamo nyanakoe reama aneno Abraham akivana rako? Opamo wene nde ai to! Anawae nanawamo wene nde mansai to! Weti Winyamo are pi Winy? Reamare Winyamo anawayo kakai siso nanuga rai to!”
Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Risyo tamo ntiti rakanijo inamarom, weamo mamaisye ramu. Injaya wepi po tamo ntiti raunande Rinai, Napirati weapo aura wapare wapa Amisy.

Weapamo wapantatukambe Amisye ai, weramu Risyamo syo aen. Muno ranivara Risyo raura syare, ‘Risyamo syantukambe Amisye ai’ weratire, indati Risyamo aarurijat akoe pi Risy maisyare weasamaisy. Weramu Syo raura tugaive: Risyamo syo Amisye aen muno ibeto Apa ayao rai.
Arono wusyinoe wapa aneno Abraham ananibe weye po ranaun Sya masyoto syare ide no mine so raije pare po raen. Tugae, soamo Abraham po Sya ide no mine so raen to, weti ananibe rave.”
Umba vatano Yahudi wo raura ware, “Nya tume mamo nseo no tename jirum eane abusyin rainya nene! Umba winyare Nyo aneno Abraham aen e?”
Yesus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Syo raura tugaive: arono Abraham avaki rainyamo, Risyamo rino to.”
Naije vatano Yahudi nanawije uparijo Ai, weti wo orame ratayao wo rave Yesus amaug ware wo aubaisy. Weramu Yesus kokaibe mansai muno puje Yavaro Amisye rai ti to kobe.

footnotes.text: Vatano Yahudi onawamo manuga mamuno vatano Samaria mansai.
Yesus apa ayao so mare Opamo po Amisye amaisy. Wemi mbewar ti vatano Yahudi uparijo Ai rave.
